generation.concept_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, a clean source image for image-to-3D.
Create ONE original full-body low-poly anime chibi male protagonist for a Korean urban side-scrolling action game. A young adult Seoul commuter newly awakened with powers, wearing ordinary contemporary clothes, EMPTY HANDS, no weapons.
Composition: ONE character only, entire body and both hands clearly visible, centered, front view with a tiny 8-degree turn to reveal form, near-orthographic camera at chest height. Strict symmetrical T-pose: straight arms horizontal at shoulder height, hands open palms downward, fingers simply formed and slightly separated; legs straight a modest distance apart, both shoes flat. Plain light gray solid background. No floor platform, props, scenery, text, labels, graphic frame, duplicate views, cast-shadow blob, or outline shell.
Proportions: exactly 3.5 heads tall from hair crown to soles, where head including hair equals 2/7 of total height. Oversized youthful head, compact torso, short but distinct thighs and calves, slightly large readable hands and sneakers. The character must feel like a young adult, not a toddler.
Visual language: deliberately low-poly mesh, clear planar surfaces, sparse broad polygon facets, simple economical geometry, clean game silhouette. Angular chunky dark charcoal hair with blue undertones, 6-8 large tapered locks, asymmetrical side-swept fringe leaving both eyes visible. Smooth pale warm face plane, big crisp illustrated slate-teal anime eyes painted onto the face with black upper lash line, tiny simple nose and mouth. Hair angular, face simple and soft. No realistic pores, individual hairs or cloth microtexture.
Outfit: cropped dark desaturated navy bomber jacket with a low collar and clean straight waist hem, worn open over a warm ivory plain crewneck T-shirt. Ribbed cuffs as simple blocks. A tiny teal rectangular seam accent on upper sleeves, no emblem, no text. Dark charcoal tapered pants with visibly separate legs and a simple waistband. Chunky ivory and charcoal everyday sneakers with teal heel tabs, plain soles. No bag, coat tails, scarf, hanging accessories, armor or glowing effects.
Color and rendering: tightly controlled navy / charcoal / warm ivory palette with restrained teal accents. Matte flat local colors, hard simple two-step cel shadows, near-unlit anime game materials, subtle faceted shading. Limited painted details only at eyes and seams. Crisp clean edges, model geometry clearly readable. Charming retro handheld 3D anime aesthetic, but render at high resolution without applying pixelation. Neutral even lighting and very little baked shading. One model, one image.

meshy_request.texture_prompt: Original Korean urban commuter anime chibi. Keep reference colors: dark charcoal angular hair, pale warm face with large crisp slate teal anime eyes, dark desaturated navy bomber jacket, plain ivory T-shirt, charcoal trousers, ivory charcoal sneakers with small teal accents. Matte flat local colors, minimal two-tone cel shading, clean painted face. No realistic cloth grain, noise, dirt, metal shine, extra logos, text, weapons, accessories or baked directional shadows. Keep silhouette and clothing faithfully.

generation.approval: User explicitly selected Meshy T2.5 Smart Topology at 15 credits.

validation.proportions: Within 3–4 head target range on front orthographic visual check; approximately 3.5 heads.
